environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL. The function URL resource policy contains a StringEquals condition on lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType set to AWS_IAM. The Lambda function's resource-based policy includes a principal constraint limiting invoke access to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/MigrationServiceRole only. The Function URL configuration specifies AuthType=AWS_IAM which requires Signature Version 4 signing on all requests. Note: the IAM auth enforcement occurs at the Lambda service layer before the function code executes — unsigned requests receive HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} from the Lambda URL invoke endpoint itself, not from application code. The MigrationServiceRole has an attached permission boundary (MigrationBoundary) that restricts lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to the specific function ARN. There is no public-facing proxy or alternate invocation path configured.

config.permission_boundary: MigrationBoundary restricts lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to function ARN arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:111222333444:function:profile-migration
